webhooks.detail: Webhooks created in Settings > Developers > Webhooks (UI); HTTP POST on record created/updated/deleted, all event types sent, HMAC SHA256 signature headers. No API-based subscription documented.

evidence.quote: Twenty sends an HTTP POST to your URL whenever a record is created, updated, or deleted.

sandbox.detail: Docs api and webhooks pages mention no sandbox, test mode or free dev account. Open-source self-hosting likely possible but not confirmed in the pages read.

evidence.quote: Your workspace-specific API documentation is available under Settings → Developers → API after creating an API key.

rate_limits.summary: 100 requests per minute; batch size 60 records per call

evidence.quote: Both REST and GraphQL support batching up to 60 records per request.
